name: How long does a typical sewer line repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sewer line repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sewer line repair varies significantly based on the complexity of the issue, the repair method chosen, and the extent of the damage. Minor repairs, such as clearing a simple blockage, might take a few hours. More extensive work, like pipe bursting or trenchless lining for a longer section, could take 1-3 days. Factors like site accessibility and weather conditions in the Las Vegas valley can also affect the timeline, making a thorough initial assessment critical for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewer line repair duration varies based on damage and method, from a few hours for minor issues to 1-3 days for extensive work.
